name: University of Lincoln

facts.text: The University of Lincoln sits on the Brayford Pool waterfront in the heart of the historic city of Lincoln; the main campus address is Brayford Pool Campus, Lincoln, LN6 7TS.
facts.sourceTitle: About the University | University of Lincoln

facts.text: Lincoln has grown from around 500 students in 1996 to over 15,000 students today, with more than 120,000 graduates across the world.
facts.sourceTitle: About the University | University of Lincoln

facts.text: Lincoln was awarded Gold in the Teaching Excellence Framework 2023, a five-star overall QS Stars rating (2023), and won the Queen's Anniversary Prize 2023.
facts.sourceTitle: About the University | University of Lincoln

facts.text: Lincoln specialises in agri-food through the Lincoln Institute for Agri-food Technology and the National Centre for Food Manufacturing at its Holbeach campus; it also has a Riseholme campus.
facts.sourceTitle: About the University | University of Lincoln

facts.text: Notable campus buildings include the Isaac Newton Building (2017) and the Ross Lucas Medical Sciences Building (2021).
facts.sourceTitle: About the University | University of Lincoln

sources.notes: Interview is part of the assessment of the CAS request form. 'The interview usually lasts between 30 to 40 minutes and will take place on Zoom (or a similar platform).' Outcome 'usually' notified within 5 working days. 'A CAS will only be issued if your pre-CAS interview is successful, you have paid your CAS deposit and all other CAS checks are complete.' Search snippet adds that for the September 2026 intake students from Nigeria will also be asked to take part. No mention of Enroly CAS Shield; platform stated as Zoom, so usesCasShield set false.
